title: Even or odd
prompt: Return "even" if n is even and "odd" if it is odd. solve(4) is "even".
hints: A number is even when dividing by 2 leaves no remainder.
The remainder operator is %, so the test is `n % 2 == 0`.

docs.name: if condition:
docs.what: Runs the indented lines below it only when the condition is true. elif and else add more branches.

docs.name: a % b
docs.what: The remainder after dividing a by b.
